@cmdNewTab.description: Command: open a new tab. Menu item, palette row, tooltip.

@cmdSplitRight.description: Command: split the focused pane into two side by side.

@cmdSplitDown.description: Command: split the focused pane into two, one above the other.

@cmdCloseTab.description: Command: close the active tab. Also the tooltip of a tab's close button.

@cmdZoomPane.description: Command: make the focused pane fill the tab, or undo it.

@cmdEqualizePanes.description: Command: give all panes of the tab the same size.

@cmdToggleSidebar.description: Command: show or hide the sidebar of vertical tabs.

@cmdRenameTab.description: Command: rename the active tab. Also in a tab's context menu.

@cmdCommandPalette.description: Command: open the command palette (menu item only).

@cmdGoToPane.description: Command: open the palette to go to a pane (menu item only).

@cmdFocusPaneLeft.description: Command: move the focus to the pane on the left.

@cmdFocusPaneRight.description: Command: move the focus to the pane on the right.

@cmdFocusPaneAbove.description: Command: move the focus to the pane above.

@cmdFocusPaneBelow.description: Command: move the focus to the pane below.

@cmdMoveDividerLeft.description: Command: move the focused pane's divider to the left.

@cmdMoveDividerRight.description: Command: move the focused pane's divider to the right.

@cmdMoveDividerUp.description: Command: move the focused pane's divider up.

@cmdMoveDividerDown.description: Command: move the focused pane's divider down.

@cmdClearScreen.description: Command: clear the focused terminal's screen and its scrollback.

@cmdClearScrollback.description: Command: clear the focused terminal's scrollback (palette row).

@cmdRestartShell.description: Command: end the pane's session and start a new shell in it.

@cmdBiggerText.description: Command: make the terminal text bigger.

@cmdSmallerText.description: Command: make the terminal text smaller.

@cmdActualSize.description: Command: go back to the default text size.

@cmdReloadGhostty.description: Command: read Ghostty's configuration again. Ghostty is a product name.

@cmdCheckForUpdates.description: Command: look for a newer version of the app.

@cmdQuitAndEndAll.description: Command: quit the app and end every session running in the server.

@menuShell.description: Title of the menu bar's first menu, of commands for tabs and panes. Terminal.app keeps the word in Chinese.

@menuFocus.description: Title of the submenu that moves the focus between panes.

@menuResize.description: Title of the submenu that moves the dividers between panes.

@menuAppearance.description: Title of the submenu that chooses light, dark or the system's appearance. Also a label of the settings control.

@menuInspector.description: Menu item that opens the developer tools (development builds only).

@menuShowTab.description: Menu item that shows the nth tab, from 1 to 9.

@paletteTitle.description: Label and tooltip of the title bar's button that opens the command palette.

palettePlaceholder: Type a command, or the name of a pane…

@palettePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the command palette's search field.

@paletteNoMatches.description: Shown in the command palette when nothing matches the query.

@paletteTabKeys.description: Badge of a pane's row in the palette: the number of its tab.

@tabListLabel.description: Accessibility label of the list of tabs.

@tabResetName.description: Tab context menu: go back to the name the panes give the tab.

@tabMoveLeft.description: Tab context menu: move the tab to the left (tabs above the panes).

@tabMoveRight.description: Tab context menu: move the tab to the right (tabs above the panes).

@tabMoveUp.description: Tab context menu: move the tab up (tabs in a sidebar).

@tabMoveDown.description: Tab context menu: move the tab down (tabs in a sidebar).

@tabCloseOthers.description: Tab context menu: close every tab but this one.

@sidebarHide.description: Label and tooltip of the button that hides the sidebar.

@sidebarShow.description: Label and tooltip of the button that shows the sidebar.

@sidebarEdge.description: Accessibility label of the edge that drags the sidebar's width.

@sidebarSettings.description: Label and tooltip of the sidebar's button that opens the settings.

@paneZoom.description: Tooltip of a pane header's button that makes the pane fill the tab.

@paneUnzoom.description: Tooltip of a pane header's button that gives the pane its size back.

@paneDivider.description: Accessibility label of the divider between two panes.

@paneNeedsAttention.description: Tooltip of the dot of a pane whose program finished or rang out of sight.

@panePrinting.description: Tooltip of the dot of a pane whose program is printing output.

@windowMinimize.description: Window button that minimizes the window (Windows).

@windowMaximize.description: Window button that maximizes the window (Windows).

@windowRestore.description: Window button that restores a maximized window (Windows).

@windowClose.description: Window button that closes the window (Windows).

@hostLabel.description: Accessibility label of the host chip in the title bar: the machine the sessions run on.

@hostLabelIssue.description: Label and tooltip of the sidebar's host button when a remote host is not connected: this machine's name, the worst host, its state, and how many more are not connected.

hostThisMachine: {os, select, darwin {This Mac} windows {This PC} other {This computer}}

@hostThisMachine.description: The machine the app runs on, as its system calls it. os is the operating system: darwin, windows or another.

@hostConnected.description: Status line of the host panel under the host's name. machine is This Mac, This PC or This computer.

@hostModel.description: Host panel row: the machine's model.

@hostChip.description: Host panel row: the machine's processor.

@hostMemory.description: Host panel row: the machine's memory.

@hostSystem.description: Host panel row: the machine's operating system.

@hostUser.description: Host panel row: the user the sessions run as.

@hostServer.description: Host panel row: the session server.

@hostSessions.description: Host panel row: the terminals, which the session server runs.

@hostServerUp.description: Host panel: the server's process id and how long it has run. uptime is a duration written by the hostDur messages.

@hostSessionCount.description: Host panel: how many sessions are open and how many run a program.

hostNote: Sessions live in the server: quit GoRex and they keep running, and come back as they were when it opens again.

@hostNote.description: Note at the foot of the host panel.

errorServerStart: GoRex could not start its session server

@errorServerStart.description: Title of the dialog shown when the session server cannot start. The dialog's message is the error.

errorServerRestart: GoRex could not restart its session server

@errorServerRestart.description: Title of the dialog shown when the stale session server cannot be restarted.

errorServerVersion: The session server is of another version of GoRex: quit and end all sessions to restart it.

@errorServerVersion.description: Banner shown when the running session server is of another version.

errorConnectionLost: Lost the connection to the session server.

@errorConnectionLost.description: Banner shown when the session server went away.

@errorSessionStart.description: Written in red in a pane whose session could not start. message is the error.

@errorDismiss.description: Label of the button that closes the error banner.

@notifyFinished.description: Title of the notification of a program that finished while the window was in the background.

@notifyIn.description: Body of that notification: the directory the program ran in.

@notifyBlocked.description: Title of the notification of a program that reported it waits for the user (program status), in a pane out of sight.

@notifyFailed.description: Title of the notification of a program that reported it failed (program status), in a pane out of sight.

@notifyOnHost.description: Where a notification comes from: a pane of a remote host.

@statusIdle.description: State a program reported (program status): at rest. Pane tooltip.

@statusWorking.description: State a program reported (program status): busy. Pane tooltip.

@statusBlocked.description: State a program reported (program status): waiting for the user. Pane tooltip.

@statusDone.description: State a program reported (program status): finished, result not seen yet. Pane tooltip.

@statusError.description: State a program reported (program status): failed and stopped. Pane tooltip.

@statusPermission.description: Why a program waits for the user (program status): it asks for permission. Pane tooltip, after the state.

@statusQuestion.description: Why a program waits for the user (program status): it asks a question. Pane tooltip, after the state.

@statusAuth.description: Why a program waits for the user (program status): it needs credentials. Pane tooltip, after the state.

@settingsAppearance.description: Settings section: how the window looks. Its title and its sidebar item.

@settingsTerminal.description: Settings section: the terminal's font and cursor.

@settingsTheme.description: Settings section: the terminal's color theme.

@settingsRemote.description: Settings section: remote access. The sidebar item.

settingsWindowHint: System follows the system, or the theme's colors.
settingsTabPlacementHint: Place tabs Above, on the Left Side, or on the Right Side of the window.

@settingsTabPlacementHint.description: Hint under the Tab placement setting. Its options are the next three messages.

@settingsPlacementAbove.description: Tab placement option: tabs above the panes.

@settingsPlacementLeft.description: Tab placement option: tabs in a sidebar on the left.

@settingsPlacementRight.description: Tab placement option: tabs in a sidebar on the right.

@settingsPaneHeaders.description: Setting: whether panes show their header.

settingsPaneHeadersHint: Pane headers are always shown when the vertical sidebar is hidden or positioned on the right.

@settingsPaneHeadersHint.description: Hint under the Show pane headers setting.

settingsTextSizeHint: Follows Ghostty's font-size ({ghostty, number, ::.0}), or {default, number, ::.0}, until set.

@settingsTextSizeHint.description: Hint under the Text size setting. font-size is Ghostty's option name; both values are sizes in points.

@settingsTextSizeValue.description: The current text size in points, next to the stepper.

@settingsReset.description: Button: go back to the default.

@settingsLanguage.description: Setting: the language of the app.

settingsLanguageHint: The language of GoRex's menus and windows. System follows the system's language.

@settingsLanguageSystem.description: Language option: use the system's language. The other options are languages named in themselves.

@settingsFollowGhostty.description: Option: set nothing, so that Ghostty's configuration applies (font and theme pickers).

@settingsCursorStyle.description: Setting: the shape of the cursor.

@settingsCursorBlock.description: Cursor style option: a filled block.

@settingsCursorBar.description: Cursor style option: a vertical bar.

@settingsCopyOnSelect.description: Setting: copy selected text to the clipboard.

settingsCopyOnSelectHint: Copies the text you select to the clipboard.

@settingsCopyOnSelectHint.description: Hint under the Copy on selection setting.

@settingsUseGhostty.description: Button: forget the choices made in the Terminal section.

settingsUseGhosttyHint: Forgets these choices, so Ghostty's config (else GoRex's defaults) applies.

@settingsSearchThemes.description: Placeholder and label of the theme search field.

@settingsGorexColors.description: Caption of the Follow Ghostty config theme when Ghostty sets no theme.

settingsMoreThemes: {count} more: type to narrow the list.

@settingsMoreThemes.description: Under the theme list when it is cut. count is how many themes are not shown.

settingsKeyboardNote: GoRex's shortcuts, which come before the terminal's keys. Ghostty keybinds are set in its config.

@settingsKeyboardNote.description: Note at the top of the Keyboard section.

@settingsShowTabRange.description: Keyboard section row: the keys that show the 1st to the 9th tab.

@settingsNextPrevTab.description: Keyboard section row: the keys that cycle through the tabs.

@settingsDevBuild.description: Version shown by a build that has none.

settingsUpdatesOff: Updates are off in development builds.

@settingsUpdatesOff.description: About section: why there is no update button.

@settingsFile.description: About section row: where the settings are kept.

@remoteTitle.description: Title of the Remote page of the settings.

@remoteAsking.description: Shown while the page waits for the server's first answer.

@remoteAllow.description: Setting: whether other machines may connect.

@remoteShare.description: Setting: whether allowed remote clients see and use every terminal of this machine (the server's sessions), or only those each opened.

remoteShareNote: Allowed clients see and use the terminals open on this machine. Off: each sees only its own.

@remoteShareNote.description: Help under the Share open terminals switch.

@remoteUnreachable.description: State: the session server does not answer.

remoteUnreachableHint: GoRex asks again every two seconds.

@remoteListening.description: State: the server accepts remote clients.

@remoteErrorRetry.description: Detail of the error state while remote access is on. error is the server's message.

remoteNotConnected: Not connected to the session server.

@remoteNotConnected.description: Error of a change attempted without a server.

@remoteSomethingWrong.description: Error when the server gave no message.

remotePasteKey: Paste the public key of the client.

@remotePasteKey.description: Error: the public key field is empty.

remoteBadKey: That is not a public key: it reads "nodekey:" and 64 hex digits. Copy it from "This machine's key" on the client.

@remoteBadKey.description: Error: the text is not a public key. nodekey: is literal; the quoted name is remoteMyKey.

remoteNameClient: Name the client, to know it in the list.

@remoteNameClient.description: Error: the client's name field is empty.

remoteAlreadyAllowed: That client is allowed already, as {name}.

@remoteAlreadyAllowed.description: Error: the key is in the list already.

@remoteCopyFailed.description: Error: the clipboard refused the text.

remoteNoAddress: The server has no address to copy.

@remoteCopied.description: Button, for a moment after it copied.

remoteMyKeyNote: Its fingerprint is what a machine you pair with shows for this one.

@remoteNoKey.description: Shown when this machine has no key.

@remoteFingerprint.description: The fingerprint of this machine's key.

remotePairNote: On the other machine, ask to pair with this server's address. Approve a request only if its fingerprint is the one that machine shows: an approved device runs commands here as your user.
remotePairTurnOn: Turn remote access on to pair.

@remotePairTurnOn.description: Shown in the pairing card while remote access is off.

@remotePairWaiting.description: Pairing is open. left is the time left, as m:ss.

remotePairOpenFor: Open for five minutes at a time.

@remotePairNoRequest.description: Shown while pairing is open and nothing was asked.

remoteAddressNote: Anyone with this address and an allowed key can run commands here as your user, like SSH.
remoteRegenerateNote: Regenerate makes a new address: the old one stops working, and the remote clients connected now are dropped.

@remoteRegenerateNote.description: Confirmation text before a new address is made.

@remoteRegenerateAsk.description: Button: ask to make a new address.

@remoteClients.description: Card: the clients allowed to connect.

remoteClientsNote: Each runs commands here as your user. Revoking one drops its connections.

@remoteNoClients.description: Shown when the list is empty.

@remoteCopyKey.description: Accessibility label of a client's copy button.

@remoteCopyKeyTip.description: Tooltip of a client's copy button.

remoteAddByKey: Or add a client by its key

@remoteAddByKey.description: Heading of the form that adds a client.

@remoteNamePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the client name field.

@remoteNameLabel.description: Accessibility label of the client name field.

@remoteKeyLabel.description: Accessibility label of the client key field.

@settingsHosts.description: Settings section: the remote hosts this machine connects to. The sidebar item and the page's title.

hostsNote: Add and manage remote GoRex hosts, view connection status, and retry connection failures.

@hostsNote.description: Note under the Remote Hosts title.

@hostsNone.description: Shown when no remote host is saved.

@hostsAdd.description: Button: open the sheet that adds a remote host.

@hostsAddTitle.description: Title of the sheet that adds a remote host.

hostsAddNote: Paste the address that Settings › Remote shows on the other machine, with remote access on there. The address is a secret: anyone with it may ask to pair.

@hostsAddNote.description: Note of the add sheet. Settings › Remote names the other machine's settings page.

@hostsAddress.description: Label of the field of the host's address.

@hostsAddressPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the address field, which hides what it holds.

@hostsName.description: Label of the field of the host's name.

@hostsNamePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the host name field.

@hostsPairAs.description: Label of the field of the name this machine pairs with.

hostsPairAsHint: How the host lists this machine.

@hostsEnterName.description: Error: the host name field is empty.

@hostsEnterAddress.description: Error: the address field is empty.

hostsBadAddress: That is not a GoRex remote address. Copy it from Settings › Remote on the host.

@hostsBadAddress.description: Error: the address does not parse.

hostsEnterPairName: Enter a name for this machine.

@hostsEnterPairName.description: Error: the pair-as field is empty.

hostsAlreadySaved: That remote host is already saved.

@hostsAlreadySaved.description: Error: a saved host has that address.

hostsNameTaken: A remote host has that name already.

@hostsNameTaken.description: Error: a saved host has that name.

@hostsConnecting.description: Host status: the first attempt to connect.

@hostsConnectingTo.description: Add sheet: connecting to the host being added.

@hostsReconnecting.description: Host status: trying again after a drop or a failure. n counts the attempts.

@hostsFailed.description: Host status: the last attempt failed; another comes.

hostsRetryNote: GoRex tries again on its own.
hostsUnreachable: Could not reach the host. Check that GoRex runs there with remote access on.

@hostsUnreachable.description: Why a host is not connected: the network or the host.

hostsNotAllowed: The host does not allow this machine. Remove it and add it again to pair.

@hostsNotAllowed.description: Why a host is not connected: this machine's key is not allowed there.

hostsNotPairing: {host} is not pairing. There, open Settings › Remote and Start pairing, then try again.

@hostsNotPairing.description: Error of the add sheet: the host's pairing window is closed. Start pairing is remotePairStart.

@hostsWaiting.description: Add sheet: the pairing request waits for the host's user.

hostsApprove: On {host}, approve the request showing this fingerprint.

@hostsApprove.description: Add sheet: what to do on the host.

hostsApproveWhere: It shows under Settings › Remote › Pair a new device. Approve it only if the fingerprints match.

@hostsApproveWhere.description: Add sheet: where the request shows on the host. Pair a new device is remotePairTitle.

@hostsFingerprint.description: Label of this machine's fingerprint on the add sheet.

@hostsRetry.description: Button: try to connect to the host now.

hostsRemoveAsk: Remove {host}? Its sessions keep running on the remote server; this window closes their tabs.

@hostsNotConnectedTo.description: Error banner: a tab or pane cannot open on a host that is not connected.

@hostsManage.description: Host panel button: open the Remote Hosts settings.

hostsSessions: {n, plural, =0 {No terminals} one {# terminal} other {# terminals}}

@hostsSessions.description: Host panel: how many terminals (panes) a host has in the window.

@cmdNewTabOn.description: Command: open a new tab on a host. host is a remote host's name or This Mac.

@paneReconnecting.description: Banner over a pane whose host is not connected.

paneConnectionDropped: The connection dropped. Sessions stay open while GoRex reconnects.

@paneConnectionDropped.description: Detail of that banner, and why a host reconnects.

paneStreamInterrupted: The terminal stream was interrupted. Reconnecting automatically.

@paneStreamInterrupted.description: Banner over a pane whose stream dropped while its host is connected.

hostsPairRejected: {host} did not approve this machine: the request was rejected, or its pairing window closed. Try again.

@hostsPairRejected.description: Error of the add sheet: the host's user rejected the request, or the pairing window closed before approving it.

@cmdNewWindow.description: Command: open a new window, which shows a new session.

@cmdNewSession.description: Command: show a new session, with one tab, in the window. A session is a set of tabs, as in Rex.

@cmdChangeSession.description: Command: open a list of the sessions, to show one in the window.

@cmdNextSession.description: Command: show the next session in the window.

@cmdPreviousSession.description: Command: show the previous session in the window.

@cmdCloseSession.description: Command: end the terminals of the window's session, after asking, and forget it.

@cmdMoveTabToNewWindow.description: Command: move the active tab to a new window, in a new session.

@sessionLabel.description: Accessibility label and tooltip of the title bar's session button. name is the session's name, as icy-ridge.

@sessionListTitle.description: Session popover: title over the list of sessions.

@sessionTabs.description: Session popover and palette: how many tabs a session has.

@sessionElsewhere.description: Session popover and palette: the session shows in another window, which choosing it focuses.

@sessionPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the command palette listing the sessions.

@sessionCloseTitle.description: Title of the question before closing a session.

sessionCloseBody: {n, plural, one {Its terminal ends, and the program running in it.} other {Its # terminals end, and the programs running in them.}}

@sessionCloseBody.description: Body of the question before closing a session: what closing it ends.

@sessionCancel.description: Button of the question before closing a session: keep it.

sessionTabsElsewhere: {n, plural, one {# tab · In another window} other {# tabs · In another window}}

@sessionTabsElsewhere.description: Session popover and palette: how many tabs a session has, which another window shows.

@windowTitle.description: Title of a window, which the Window menu and the taskbar show: its session's name and its active tab's label.

@remoteNetTitle.description: Card title: a coordinator network to join once instead of pairing.

remoteNetNote: Pairing every machine with every other is no way to scale. A coordinator turns remote access into a network, the way Tailscale does: join once with the network key, and every member trusts and finds every other.
remoteNetTurnOn: Turn remote access on to join a network.

@remoteNetTurnOn.description: Said while remote access is off.

@remoteNetKeyPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the network key field.

remoteNetURL: Paste the join URL the coordinator printed.

@remoteNetJoined.description: Card title: the network joined, name this machine's member name.

remoteNetCoordinator: Members come from the coordinator at {host}, and change with it.

@remoteNetCoordinator.description: Note under the title: host the coordinator's address.

remoteNetNoMembers: No other machine has joined yet.

@remoteNetError.description: error is the coordinator's last word.

@paneRename.description: Context menu item for a pane.

@paneResetName.description: Context menu item for a pane.

@paneMoveTab.description: Submenu of the tabs a pane moves to.

@paneMoveWindow.description: Submenu of the windows a pane moves to.

@cmdFind.description: Command palette and menu: open the find bar of the focused pane.

@findNext.description: Find bar: select the next match toward older output.

@findPrevious.description: Find bar: select the previous match.

@findClose.description: Close the find bar and clear its highlights.

@findPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the find bar input.

@findCount.description: Find bar: the selected match and how many were found.

@remoteShareLayout.description: Remote access: share this window layout with remote clients.

remoteShareLayoutNote: Remote clients may read this window's tabs and splits, and follow changes.

@remoteShareLayoutNote.description: Remote access: share this window layout with remote clients.

@remoteClientShare.description: Switch: this remote client may use all sessions.

@remoteClientLayout.description: Switch: this remote client may read the layout.
